description: Project-scoped dry-run validation for a field rule (FORMULA). Always returns HTTP 200.

parameters.name: Accept-Language
parameters.description: Locale for localized response messages (for example: en, fr-FR, pseudo)

data.description: Dry-run validation result for a field rule (always HTTP 200)

valid.description: True when the rule would save successfully

result_type.description: Inferred result type when the expression parsed

expression.description: Canonical infix expression when parse succeeded

operand_fields.description: Field names referenced by the expression

items.description: A single validate-on-save issue for a field rule

400.description: The server could not understand the request due to invalid syntax or parameters that fail to meet validation requirements.

401.description: Although the HTTP standard specifies "unauthorized", semantically this response means "unauthenticated". That is, the client must authenticate itself to get the requested response.

403.description: The client does not have access rights to the content; that is, it is authenticated, but the server is refusing to give the requested resource. Unlike 401, the client's identity is known to the server.

404.description: The server can not find the requested resource. This can mean either the URL is not recognized, or the resource itself does not exist. Servers may also send this response instead of 403 to hide the existence of a resource from an unauthorized client.

422.description: The request was well-formed but was unable to be followed due to semantic errors.

schema.description: Dry-run validation request for a FORMULA field rule (same body as grouped create)

rule_type.description: Rule type to validate; must be FORMULA

rule_group_id.description: Optional group id. An edit dry-run excludes every row in this group from the duplicate-scope check. Accepted so the body matches grouped create.

asset_type_ids.description: Asset type ids the formula applies to. Same as grouped create.

items.description: Asset type ids the formula applies to. Same as grouped create.

trigger_fields.description: Target fields the formula writes. Same as grouped create.

items.description: Target fields the formula writes. Same as grouped create.

conditions.description: Conditions AST for a conditional-validation rule

root.description: Root node of the recursive conditions tree

is_active.description: Whether the created rules would be active

message.description: Optional message. Ignored for FORMULA; accepted so the body matches grouped create.

expression.description: Infix expression for FORMULA. Same top-level field as grouped create. Do not send root. Maximum 512 characters.

rule_id.description: Existing rule id when validating an update; omit for create
